title: Subscribe in an Effect, unsubscribe in cleanup

slides.say: Need to listen to a browser event like scroll? Subscribe in an Effect.
Add the listener in the Effect, and remove the same function in the cleanup.

slides.text: Dev: add → remove → add. Only one listener is ever active.
slides.say: In development React adds, removes, then adds again. Only one subscription is active at a time, just like production.

slides.text: Subscribed in setup? Unsubscribe in cleanup.
slides.say: Rule: whatever you subscribe to in setup, unsubscribe from in cleanup.
